representation.shell_command:
set -eu
python - "$(inputs.expression.path)" "$(inputs.metadata.path)" <<'PY'
from __future__ import print_function
import csv
import sys
from collections import Counter
import numpy as np
import sklearn
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

expr_path = sys.argv[1]
meta_path = sys.argv[2]

with open(meta_path, 'r') as handle:
    reader = csv.reader(handle)
    meta_header = next(reader)
    meta_rows = [row for row in reader if row]

if not meta_header or meta_header[0] != 'projid':
    raise ValueError('Expected projid as first metadata column')
meta_ids = [row[0] for row in meta_rows]
meta_counts = Counter(meta_ids)
repeated_meta_ids = set(k for k, v in meta_counts.items() if v > 1)

with open(expr_path, 'r') as handle:
    reader = csv.reader(handle)
    expr_header = next(reader)
    if not expr_header or expr_header[0] != 'gene':
        raise ValueError('Expected gene as first expression column')
    sample_ids = expr_header[1:]
    sample_counts = Counter(sample_ids)
    repeated_expr_ids = set(k for k, v in sample_counts.items() if v > 1)
    if repeated_expr_ids != repeated_meta_ids:
        raise ValueError('Repeated primary-ID sets differ between expression and metadata')
    if set(sample_ids) != set(meta_ids):
        raise ValueError('Expression and metadata primary-ID sets differ')
    keep_indices = [i for i, sid in enumerate(sample_ids) if sid not in repeated_expr_ids]
    kept_sample_ids = [sample_ids[i] for i in keep_indices]
    if len(kept_sample_ids) != len(set(kept_sample_ids)):
        raise ValueError('Retained sample IDs are not unique')
    genes = []
    columns = []
    for row in reader:
        if len(row) != len(expr_header):
            raise ValueError('Expression row width mismatch')
        genes.append(row[0])
        columns.append([float(row[i + 1]) for i in keep_indices])

X = np.asarray(columns, dtype=np.float64).T
if X.shape[0] != len(kept_sample_ids):
    raise ValueError('Sample axis mismatch')
if X.shape[1] != len(genes):
    raise ValueError('Gene axis mismatch')
if not np.isfinite(X).all():
    raise ValueError('Non-finite expression value')
if (X < 0).any():
    raise ValueError('log10(x+1) requires nonnegative expression values')

X = np.log10(X + 1.0)
variance_mask = np.var(X, axis=0) > 0.0
X_fit = X[:, variance_mask]
n_components = 100
if n_components > min(X_fit.shape):
    raise ValueError('Requested component count exceeds fitted matrix rank bound')

model = PCA(n_components=n_components, svd_solver='full', whiten=False)
model.fit(X_fit)
pc1_fraction = float(model.explained_variance_ratio_[0])
pc1_percent = 100.0 * pc1_fraction

with open('result.tsv', 'w') as out:
    out.write('metric\tvalue\n')
    out.write('pc1_explained_variance_percent\t{:.17g}\n'.format(pc1_percent))
    out.write('pc1_explained_variance_fraction\t{:.17g}\n'.format(pc1_fraction))
    out.write('n_components\t{}\n'.format(n_components))
    out.write('n_expression_columns_original\t{}\n'.format(len(sample_ids)))
    out.write('n_unique_primary_ids_original\t{}\n'.format(len(set(sample_ids))))
    out.write('n_repeated_primary_ids_excluded\t{}\n'.format(len(repeated_expr_ids)))
    out.write('n_samples_fitted\t{}\n'.format(X_fit.shape[0]))
    out.write('n_genes_original\t{}\n'.format(X.shape[1]))
    out.write('n_zero_variance_genes_removed\t{}\n'.format(int((~variance_mask).sum())))
    out.write('n_genes_fitted\t{}\n'.format(X_fit.shape[1]))
    out.write('transform\tlog10(x+1)\n')
    out.write('feature_centering\ttrue\n')
    out.write('feature_scaling\tfalse\n')
    out.write('svd_solver\tfull\n')
    out.write('sklearn_version\t{}\n'.format(sklearn.__version__))
PY
